title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Refund of Program Credit Balances: Desk Reference
content:
**Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — refund of a program's credit balance at the lender's request.**

**Scope.** When a lender asks for the credit balance on an active or suspended program to be refunded, and only then, the refund paid on that request is the refundable credit figured by this refund schedule; a credit balance on a terminated program is still refunded to the lender in full at termination.

**When the refund is figured.**

> The refund is not figured until the program account carries, for the certificate named on every borrower evidence on file that meets the acceptance rule, a credit booked on a cancellation for confirmed borrower coverage, unless that certificate had already been cancelled for another reason.

> The refund is fixed only after every certificate whose current term expires today, other than one carrying a cancellation entry, one for which acceptable borrower evidence has been received or a run-off certificate of a terminated program, carries a renewal entry for the following term.

> The refund is fixed only after the loan named on the program's most recently mailed first notice, once that notice is more than the borrower notice period old with no acceptable borrower evidence received since it, carries a certificate issued on or after that notice.

**What the refund books.** A refund disbursement to the lender on the program account on the statement for the current month, with a newly assigned refund payment reference; the amount the lender owes on the program rises by the refund, bringing a credit balance toward zero.

## Tool: `refund_program_credit_d16acbc2`

An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `refund_program_credit_d16acbc2` and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `forceplaced_program_id` | Reference number of the lender's master program whose credit balance is refunded, as returned by the master program lookup | Identifier |
| `refund_amount` | The amount paid back to the lender | Positive USD amount with 2 decimals, rounded half to even to the cent on booking |

**Return.** A confirmation giving the refund entry reference, the newly assigned refund payment reference (letters followed by digits), the amount refunded with its statement month (YYYY-MM), and the program's amount owed net of the refund (a negative figure is a credit balance still due to the lender). A payment reference in the reply indicates the refund was issued.
